scope: CVG-003 bounded ABAC enforcement and metadata auditability on POST /internal/events/:eventId/reprocess

criteria.description: The reprocess route retains RBAC audit.write, invokes principal-derived audit.write ABAC with audit_entry/event/account context before any EventBus lookup or requeue, and a denial prevents EventBus and audit access.
criteria.limitations: This certifies the selected HTTP route branch only; it does not certify worker authorization or distributed replay after revocation.

criteria.description: The ABAC policy catalog explicitly permits admin and denies every non-admin role for audit.write on audit_entry, while the existing global unmatched-action behavior remains unchanged.
criteria.limitations: This does not authorize a systemic ABAC default-deny redesign or policy expansion.

criteria.description: A successful account-scoped reprocess preserves the existing 404/202 and failed/retrying EventBus contracts and appends only metadata-level actor/account/correlation/status/result audit information without raw payload.
criteria.limitations: The existing appendAudit helper is intentionally fire-and-forget; durable audit atomicity with requeue remains a separate follow-up.

criteria.description: The API server supplies the existing callback and both authenticated HTTP directions are evidenced: admin reaches the existing lookup contract and a non-admin with RBAC audit.write receives 403 before lookup; OpenAPI remains valid.
criteria.limitations: The server integration uses a missing event for the admin path and a repository fixture for the non-admin path; it does not claim durable target-environment reprocess execution.

criteria.description: Final local regression and quality evidence pass: API 493/493, access-control 39/39, event-bus 25/25, official coverage above 80%, typechecks, OpenAPI, RLS, secret scan, formatting and diff hygiene.
criteria.limitations: Local evidence does not replace remote CI, external homologation, target operations or release acceptance.

criteria.description: Independent reviews are reconciled with no in-scope P0/P1 blocker, and fresh global audits confirm non-promotion: Vetus 4/11 verified, clinical 2/3 verified, readiness 95/100 with 42 PASS, 3 WARN and 1 FAIL.
criteria.limitations: Generic ABAC 403 detail redaction, replay-after-revocation/idempotency, durable audit atomicity and operational-coverage source-of-truth remain explicit residuals.

gaps: Generic ABAC denial responses can disclose matched policy metadata through generic ForbiddenError.details; hardening remains outside this route-only authority.
Replay-after-revocation and idempotency semantics are not re-evaluated by this bounded route slice and remain a separate P1 residual.
Audit persistence is not atomic with EventBus reprocessing because the existing helper is fire-and-forget; storage/UoW changes remain outside scope.
GET /audit/operational-coverage has a separate persisted source-of-truth/cache gap and remains the next P1 scouting candidate.

Global Vetus functional parity remains not verified at 4/11 areas; clinical parity remains not verified at 2/3 areas; enterprise readiness remains 95/100 with external warnings and one parity failure.
conditions: Close only POST /internal/events/:eventId/reprocess, its existing server seam, explicit abac-009 policy, metadata-only success audit and matching OpenAPI contract as PASS_BOUNDED.
Preserve principal-derived account scope, RBAC audit.write, 404/202 behavior, failed/retrying eligibility and worker/repository contracts.

Keep generic ABAC error-detail redaction, replay-after-revocation/idempotency, durable audit atomicity, operational coverage, other routes, workers, providers, target, production, deployment and release work outside this gate unless newly authorized.
Keep CVG-003/global ERP IN_PROGRESS/PARTIAL and promotion BLOCKED.
Do not infer target, production, provider, deployment or release acceptance from this gate.

authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation request and fresh bounded scout selection
authority.scope: Bounded HTTP reprocess RBAC/ABAC/audit route and matching policy, tests and OpenAPI only
authority.decision: Authorize only the existing enforceAbac server callback, explicit admin-only audit.write policy, metadata-only successful audit and route/server/test/OpenAPI changes. Exclude operational coverage, distributed replay/revocation, idempotency, generic ABAC error redaction, storage/UoW, workers, migrations, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing generic ABAC errors, replay/idempotency semantics, durable audit atomicity, operational coverage, another event family or any excluded environment boundary.

next_action: Return to fresh bounded scouting, prioritizing the operational-coverage source-of-truth candidate; do not promote CVG-003 or global ERP readiness.
revalidation_triggers: Durable atomicity between reprocess mutation and audit persistence
Changes to abac-009 or policy semantics
Expansion to workers, migrations, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment or release scope
